candidates.description: This feature represents the concept of military invasion, subjugation, and territorial conquest.
This feature vector activates on words related to historical eras, dynasties, or the passage of time and succession.
This vector represents concepts related to changes in quantity, size, or status.
This feature represents military personnel, armed forces, and religious clergy involved in defense or service.
This vector activates on words and subwords related to imperial power, sovereignty, and historical governance.
This vector represents terms related to social groups, communities, and collective affiliations, particularly emphasizing tribal organizations and related military or cultural forces.
This feature vector represents socioeconomic status, civic entitlements, and power dynamics among individuals in society.
This feature vector represents royalty, nobility, and monarchical rule.
This feature vector represents historical or forceful subjugation and conflict, characterized by terms related to slavery, invasion, and piracy.
This feature vector represents the concept of exerting control, power, or influence, as well as competitive dominance.
